lines.x: A sharp Friday sell-off on Wall Street sent U.S.
Australia's unemployment rate surged to 4.9% in October, reaching a five-year high as employment plunged by 43,500.

The Australian dollar declined and Australian government bond yields fell to three-month lows after October employment data showed a second consecutive monthly job loss, increasing expectations of interest rate cuts in 2027.

The S&P/ASX 200 lost 1.8% to hit a multi-day low as heavyweights in the mining and financial sectors sank, while the Australian dollar fell to a 10-month low of $0.6728 following Reserve Bank warnings of upside inflation risks.
